questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Bring warm clothes when you arrive in january, it was sooo cold because the houses are not insulstet snd they only have thin blankets. Dont be afraid about Mexico being dangerous, just use your human understanding. And be Open to the things that come.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: I was surprised about how many Small assignments and presentations we had during the semester. It is not Hard but you just Need to keep an eye on the deadlines

questions.answer: Being able to live in a foreign country with different Culture and learning a new Language. Also being among people from all Afros the Globe is very giving!

questions.answer: Time difference to denmark when wanting to talk to Friends and Family
